title: Resting heart rate above your normal
meaning: Your resting heart rate has stayed above your own normal for several days. Less sleep, stress, too little water or hard exercise can all raise it.
actions: Keep your usual sleep and wake times
Repeat the check tomorrow morning at the same time
Tell the flight surgeon if it keeps rising

title: Blood oxygen a little low
meaning: Your blood oxygen is slightly below the safe range. A cold or moving finger can give a low reading.
actions: Re-measure with a warm, still finger
Repeat the check in a few minutes

title: Skin temperature outside the safe range
meaning: Forehead skin temperature is outside its safe range. It is not core body temperature, and the room, exercise or a cold forehead can change it.
actions: Wait a few minutes in a comfortable spot
Tell the flight surgeon if you also feel unwell

title: Feeling dizzy
meaning: Dizziness has many possible causes. This is guidance, not a diagnosis.
actions: Sit or hold on and stay still
Contact the flight surgeon if it does not pass or you feel worse

title: Feeling very tired
meaning: Tiredness is common and is often linked to sleep, food, water and workload.
actions: Think about how much you slept and ate today
Tell the flight surgeon if it lasts for days

title: Headache
meaning: Headaches are common and have many causes. A sudden, severe headache is an emergency: use the I feel unwell now button.
actions: Tell the flight surgeon if it lasts or keeps coming back
